messages:
maeve (sec-eng): quick heads-up — during this quarter's access review I found 3 service accounts with kms.admin on prod keys: svc-payments-prod, svc-analytics, svc-backfill. also noticed a ~3hr gap (2026-03-17 02:10-05:15 UTC) where key access/mgmt events are missing from audit logs in us-west1. putting notes here for visibility and action.

audit-bot: automated-scan: KMS_IAM_MISMATCH detected on project/redwood-prod, keys: 3, last_seen: 2026-03-17T05:16:02Z. missing events window: 2026-03-17T02:10:00Z - 2026-03-17T05:15:00Z. ticket: #INC-4129

raj (eng-infra): thanks, maeve. can you paste the exact IAM bindings you saw? also, do we have any SLOs/alerts tied to KMS audit ingest that might have tripped?

maeve (sec-eng): pasted below (copied from gcloud policy get):

```
resource: projects/redwood-prod/locations/us-west1/keyRings/payments/cryptoKeys/pay_key
bindings:
  - role: roles/cloudkms.admin
    members:
      - serviceAccount:svc-payments-prod@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

same pattern for svc-analytics and svc-backfill on different keys. audit ingestion alert did not fire — looks like the logs never arrived rather than being throttled. no evidence of key use during gap from our token-service metrics.

olivia (eng-sre): ok. safest approach: 1) run a read-only confirm script across all projects to enumerate KMS bindings + last access time, 2) pick a non-prod analog to test removal, 3) schedule a 30m canary prune during low traffic, 4) monitor for failures and immediate rollback. I can run step 1 now if infra ok.

chris (platform): +1 to olivia. infra: can we run this command across org to produce a csv? i propose:

```
for PROJECT in $(gcloud projects list --format=\"value(projectId)\"); do
  gcloud kms keys list --location=\"us-west1\" --project=$PROJECT --format=\"json\" | jq '.[] | {project: \"$PROJECT\", name: .name, iam: .iamPolicy}'
done > kms_bindings.json
```

we should also query lastCryptoKeyVersionState and access logs: stackdriver logs filter: \"resource.type=crypto_key AND protoPayload.methodName:decrypt OR protoPayload.methodName:asymmetricDecrypt\"

raj (eng-infra): i can run that script. i'll run it in a read-only job in infra-tools account and drop results in gs://redwood-sec-audit/kms/1962345678-report.csv. target ETA 2h. will also check audit ingestion pipelines (pubsub->bigquery connector). if pipeline paused, that explains missing events.

zoe (legal): keep me posted. if there's any deletion or role removal affecting production keys we need to log approvals and retain pre-removal snapshots for compliance. please attach the audit-bot output + before/after IAM snapshots to the ticket.

maeve (sec-eng): noted. plan proposed: (A) infra runs enumeration and ingestion check (raj) — 2h; (B) olivia will pick canary project (non-prod mirror) and run removal test — within 4h after A; (C) if canary clean, chris to run staged prune on low-traffic window (2 deploy windows: 03:00-03:30 UTC or 13:00-13:30 UTC) with rollback playbook; (D) legal retains snapshots. will create the PRD and link to INC-4129.

olivia (eng-sre): i'll run the canary in sandbox-payments and add synthetic traffic while monitoring errors and key-access metrics. if error rate >0.5% in 10m we rollback. posting runbook snippet here:

```
- pre-check: snapshot IAM (gcloud iam roles get-policy)
- remove role: gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding ... --member=serviceAccount:... --role=roles/cloudkms.admin
- monitor: logs, token-service, payments-latency, error-rate
- rollback: re-add binding and verify
```

chris (platform): I'll prepare the automation to re-add bindings in <5m for rollback and include a short-circuit to abort if error spikes. will also ensure service account key rotation is ok if we temporarily change roles.

raj (eng-infra): running enumeration now. pipeline check: pubsub subscription for audit-ingest shows intermittent NACKs around 2026-03-17T02:00-05:00 UTC due to a downstream BigQuery load job backlog. i'm kicking a re-delivery and backfill job. if backfill succeeds the missing events will appear and we'll re-evaluate whether any access happened during the window.

maeve (sec-eng): perfect — please upload the full CSV and backfill logs to the ticket. once backfill and enumeration are done we can decide whether to proceed with canary. thanks all.

audit-bot: ticket #INC-4129 updated: enumeration started by raj (eng-infra). backfill job queued. next update expected within 2 hours. :gear:
